title: Regularized Coupling Maps on Matrix Polytopes: From Assignment to Graph Matching and Optimal Transport
summary: Three classical problems-linear assignment, graph matching, and optimal transport-share a common structure: they seek an optimal matrix-valued coupling on a matrix polytope. We study regularized coupling maps that encompass two families of regularization: entropy/KL regularization, which exponentiates the input score matrix and projects it onto the relevant matrix polytope via the KL-projection; and the Frobenius/Euclidean regularization, which performs the Euclidean projection of the scaled input matrix onto the same polytope.
